statusNote: Compared with Run 1: the pink brick was lifted off the plate and re-placed, and the blue slope was picked, set down on the table and picked again, so steps repeat. Cycle 17.2 s vs 5.5 s.

elements.label: Idle before cycle
elements.observed: Three loose parts on the table: blue slope, white plate, pink brick. A hand rests still at the lower right frame edge.

elements.label: Reach and grasp pink 1×6 brick
elements.observed: Lower-right hand moves to the pink brick and picks it up; a second hand enters from the top right at about 0.9 s.

elements.label: Bring plate to working position
elements.observed: Upper hand reaches the white plate and moves it down to the lower hand; plate is no longer at its start position by 1.5 s.
elements.flag: Hands partly hide the plate move; reference leaves the plate on the table

elements.label: Place pink brick on plate
elements.observed: Pink brick brought to the plate and lowered lengthwise against it; hands cover most of it.

elements.label: Hold the base plate
elements.observed: Lower hand keeps hold of the plate edge for nearly the whole cycle, holding it on the table and not lifting it.

elements.label: Press pink brick down
elements.observed: Upper hand fingers press along the pink brick on the plate; the hand hides most of the brick.

elements.label: Reach and grasp blue 2×2 slope
elements.observed: Upper hand leaves the plate, picks the blue slope from its start spot at the top and lifts it by 3.1 s.

elements.label: Hold blue slope near plate
elements.observed: Blue slope held in the upper hand's fingertips above the table beside the plate; not yet placed. Pink brick lies on the plate edge.
elements.flag: Slope held for about 1.9 s without placing; Run 1 carries and places it

elements.label: Lift pink brick off plate
elements.observed: Upper hand grips the pink brick and lifts it clear of the plate; the plate stays in the lower hand.
elements.flag: Pink brick removed after being placed (redo); not in Run 1

elements.label: Place pink brick on plate (again)
elements.observed: Pink brick held over the plate and lowered back onto it by the upper hand.
elements.flag: Pink brick placed a second time

elements.label: Set blue slope down
elements.observed: Blue slope is no longer in hand; it lies on the table above the hands by 7.0 s, while the upper hand holds the pink brick.
elements.flag: Slope put back on the table; not in Run 1

elements.label: Press pink brick down (again)
elements.observed: Upper hand presses along the pink brick again; at about 7.7 s the brick appears to be lifted briefly.
elements.flag: Pink brick pressed a second time; possible extra lift at 7.7 s (unconfirmed)

elements.label: Reach and grasp blue 2×2 slope (again)
elements.observed: Upper hand leaves the plate, moves to the blue slope lying on the table and picks it up; slope gone from the table by 9.9 s.

elements.label: Carry blue slope
elements.observed: Upper hand with the slope hovers beside the plate with open fingers; slope mostly hidden by the hand.
elements.flag: Slope hidden in hand; carry much longer than Run 1

elements.label: Position and orient blue slope
elements.observed: Slope held against the side of the pink brick, then left on the plate by 12.9 s as the upper hand withdraws.

elements.label: Press blue slope down
elements.observed: Upper hand returns and adjusts and presses the slope and pink brick on the plate from 13.4 s; hands hide the pressing.
elements.flag: Hands hide the pressing; much longer than Run 1

elements.label: Release and set down
elements.observed: Assembly set down on the table; both hands withdraw to the frame edge by 17.7 s.

elements.label: Idle after cycle
elements.observed: Finished assembly alone on the table; a hand rests still at the lower right frame edge.

processData: Count of repeated picks and placements
Time with a part held without placing
Idle time before and after the cycle
limitations: Hands hide the pressing and which studs are used
Slope is hidden in the hand for 9.9-12.4 s
Exact stud rows in the finished state cannot be confirmed from this camera angle

source.note: Claude Code, frame by frame at 0.1 s steps

differences: Pink brick lifted off the plate by the upper hand at about 5.6-6.0 s and placed again from 6.0 s; Run 1 places it once.
Blue slope picked at about 2.9 s, held in fingers to 5.2 s, set down on the table by 7.0 s and picked up again at about 9.6 s; Run 1 picks it once and places it.
Pink brick appears lifted a second time at about 7.7 s (unconfirmed).
Slope placed at 12.5 s, about 9.6 s later than Run 1 (3.1 s placing start); long hand work at the plate 13.0-17.3 s vs 1.0 s.
Finished plate is rotated about 25 degrees and the slope appears nearer the top rows than in Run 1 (unconfirmed).

finalState.note: All three parts are on the plate: pink 1×6 along the plate's second column, blue slope to its right. The plate is rotated about 25 degrees and the slope appears nearer the top rows than the centre rows in Run 1; exact studs cannot be confirmed.
